Name: Get Laid with Shane
Author: elffunction
Description:
[center][b][font=Tahoma][color=#cc4125][size=5]拒绝N网以外的二传及牟利
[size=4]﻿[/size][size=3]DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUS[/size][/size]
[size=4]请支持原创作者[/size][/color][/font][/b][/center]
[center]~中文简介请下滑~[/center][b][size=3][b][size=3]DISCRIPTION：
[/size][/b][/size][/b]This mod adds 18+ content to the game's vanilla events for Shane's 10-Heart & 14-Heart event, as well as additional letters and dialogues (for Shane and other NPCs)

[b]10 Hearts [/b]After the ball game Shane returned to Marnie's ranch with the farmer, had a memorable night with you in his room, and you seriously confessed your love to him.
[b]14 Hearts [/b]After clearing up the misunderstanding, Shane and you talked about video games at the Saloon, and you told him about a dream you'd had. 

~ Total redemption and fluff (or is it?) ~

The total word count for the event and additional content is about [font=Times New Roman][size=4][b]9k[/b][/size][/font]
The event is a bit long, so make sure you've got enough time before reading this.
There are numerous branches within the event, most of which do not affect the overall direction of the event, nor do they affect friendship!
If you're curious about other branching options after the event is over, you can download the text at [font=Times New Roman][b]Optional Files[/b][/font]!
\\\\\\ 


[b][color=#f6b26b][size=4]Notes：[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*](Highlighted) Top!Farmer / Bottom!Shane ！！！
[*]Due to relevant depictions, the plot is more suitable for *male* players [color=#cccccc][s](if you don't mind, forget it)[/s][/color]
[*]This mod will be *overridden* by any other mod that changes Shane-related events
[*]It is required that the player has not watched the 10 & 14 hearts events before！
[*][color=#f6b26b]If you turn off [font=Times New Roman]EventChanges[/font] in [b]Immersive Characters - Shane[/b] in your settings (set to false) it will be compatible with this mod![/color]
[*][color=#f6b26b]Other mods that only change dialogues are (perhaps) also compatible, but if multiple mods have conflicting dialogues on one day, it can lead to being swallowed without affecting the normal operation of the game (yeah you won't even notice that)[/color]
[/list] \\\\\\



[quote][size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size]
①Download and unzip Get Laid with Shane
②Place the mod into the Mods folder in the game directory
\\\\\\[/quote]


 \\\\\\[size=3]
[b]How do I know this Mod is running?
[/b][/size]It is known that Shane's 10 Hearts event starts with him inviting the player to the farm in the morning, and I have modified this dialogue as well.
If this dialog is modified, then Get Laid is running normally and has not been overwritten.
See the spoiler file for more details on the modifications![size=3]
[/size][size=3]

[b]P.S. For English version users, I hope you can read the ReadMe for there's something important about the translation of this mod I want to inform you.[/b]





[/size] \\\\\\[b][size=3]
介绍：
[/size][/b]本模组在游戏原有剧情的基础上为谢恩的10心事件、14心事件增加了R18内容，还有额外的信件和对话（包括谢恩和其他NPC）

[b]10心 [/b]球赛后谢恩带着农场主回到了玛妮的牧场，在他的房间里被吃干抹净，你认真地向他告了白
[b]14心 [/b]解除误会后，谢恩和你在星之果实餐吧里谈论了电子游戏，你和他讲述了你曾做过的一个梦

~一款单向救赎双向箭头的纯爱剧情~

事件及附带内容总字数约[b][font=Times New Roman][size=4]1w5[/size][/font][/b]，事件内容较长，建议在时间充裕的情况下观看！
事件内有众多分支，大部分不影响事件整体走向，也不会影响好感度！
如果在事件结束后好奇其他分支选项，可在[b][font=Times New Roman]Optional Files[/font][/b]处下载文案观看！
\\\\\\ 


[b][color=#f6b26b][size=4]注意事项：[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][u][b](高亮) [u][b]农场主/谢恩，左右有意义[/b][/u][/b][/u][/size]
[*]由于相关描写，本模组剧情更适配[b]*男性*[/b]玩家[s][color=#cccccc]（如果不介意当我没说）[/color][/s]
[*]这个模组会[b]*被*[/b]任何其他改变谢恩相关事件的模组覆盖
[*]要求玩家此前没看过谢恩的10心和14心事件
[*][color=#f6b26b]如果你在设置中将[b]Immersive Characters – Shane[/b]中的[font=Times New Roman]EventChanges[/font]关闭（设定为false）就可以和本模组兼容[/color]
[*][color=#f6b26b]其他只修改了对话的模组（应该）也是兼容的，但是如果在某一天多个Mod的对话有冲突，就可能导致被吞，但不影响游戏正常运行（被吞掉后这段特殊对话就没办法再被触发了）[/color]
[/list] \\\\\\



[quote][size=3][b]安装方式：[/b][/size]
①下载，解压
②将本模组放入游戏目录下的Mods文件夹
\\\\\\[/quote]


 \\\\\\[b][size=3]
如何知道本Mod在运行？
[/size][/b]众所周知谢恩10心事件是从他早上到农场邀请玩家开始的，而我对这段对话也做了修改
如果这段对话是被修改的状态，那么说明Get Laid在正常运行，没有被覆盖~
关于具体的修改内容，详见spoiler文件




 \\\\\\
[b]Last but not least：[/b]
I was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/917]Make Love with Shane[/url], so I made this mod!
I love the *needed* and *being needed* relationship between Shane and the farmer, and have always wanted to bring it out in the game by mods! Well, I ended up with this, finally!
If you like it please don't forget to click that little endorse~ Your support is my biggest motivation <3
Hope you enjoy!!!

[b]最后：[/b]
我从[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/917]Make Love with Shane[/url]获得了灵感而制作了这个模组。
我很喜欢谢恩和农场主之间*需要*和*被需要*的关系，也一直想通过mod的方式在游戏里把它展现出来！于是最后自割腿肉了！
如果您喜欢请不要忘记点一个小小的endorse~你的支持就是我最大的动力 <3
祝您吃得开心！！！
